chunks: We delivered Moses and everyone with him, all together.
ai.seo_question: Who did God save along with Moses in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'Jam'' (collective salvation), affirming that the faithful who remained steadfast with Musa (AS) were preserved as a unified body, reflecting the divine promise of victory for the believers. This event serves as a paradigmatic example of God's power to rescue the oppressed from tyrannical forces, a theme frequently cited in Shia theological discussions regarding the ultimate triumph of the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers.
